name: lecture-notes-to-outline
title_zh: 讲义进 Outline 前先过一遍你的口吻
tagline_zh: PPT 或 PDF 塞进 Outline 时，它不照抄原文，而是按你讲课的口气重写成完整但精简的笔记。
tagline_en: Feeds PPT/PDF into Outline as complete-but-synthetic notes, rephrased in your lecturing tone with hierarchy.
desc_en: Use when asked to take, write, or publish notes from a lecture, course slide deck, seminar, or PDF/PPTX into Outline -- including phrasings like "take notes of TopicN.pdf on outline", "put this lecture in the right page/collection", "note this course in outline", or any request to turn university/course material into an Outline document. Also use when notes must be "complete but synthetic", or whe
why_zh: 它先读完整份材料再动笔，不是抽取关键词，而是把幻灯片之间的逻辑缝补成连贯叙述，产物可直接当课堂笔记发布。
why_en: Reads the whole deck before writing, stitches slide logic into flowing prose instead of keyword extraction, and outputs.
limit_zh: 只认 Outline 为目标格式，不输出 Markdown 或 Word。
limit_en: Outputs Outline only, no MD/Word. Needs structured slides (PPT/PDF with headings); scanned images or audio fail. Default tone is academic, not casual.
title_en: Lecture slides become Outline notes in your voice
